newsitem.title: USA: Alabama jobless rate drops to 4.5 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Alabama jobless rate drops to 4.5 pct in August.

text.p: Alabama's unemployment rate dropped to 4.5 percent in August from 4.8 percent in July and 6.5 percent a year ago, the state Department of Industrial Relations said Monday.
The August unemployment rate was the state's lowest since 1974. It represented 93,900 unemployed Alabama residents, down from 100,800 in July and 134,200 a year ago.

Dottie Blair Cieszynski, director of the Department of Industrual Relations, said the state gained 2,900 factory jobs over the month, an unexpected jump after a long decline in the manufacturing sector.
